content:
priya_cs: Heads-up — Ceres cutover this Thurs 09:00 PT. Final preflight for private/VPC deploy. Need signoff on: network peering, route tables, IAM role trust, KMS key policy, and audit-forwarding. @leo_net @kevin_se @sam_am :eyes:
leo_net: I can validate. Do we have final CIDR ranges + peer account ID? Need to confirm route propagation and NAT config.
priya_cs: CIDRs: Ceres VPC 10.50.0.0/16, Redwood VPC 10.10.0.0/16. Peering will be created by infra but we must add routes into the appropriate RTs. Doc: https://redwood.atlassian/ceres/onboard (see section 'network').
sam_am: Customer asks that KMS key rotation aligns with their quarterly window. Also confirm principal ARNs we grant to (they require explicit role names).
kevin_se: Draft KMS policy below — review and flag anything missing:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-inference-service" },
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
priya_cs: SGTM. Two edits: add `kms:Decrypt` explicitly for the role used by redwood-inference-service (already present) and add condition "aws:SourceIp": ["203.0.113.0/24"] to limit to their VPN egress IPs. Also include the rotation schedule note.
leo_net: Route update will be in terraform. I'll open a PR with `aws_route` entries and a small test harness. Snippet: `resource "aws_route" "to_ceres" { route_table_id = var.rt_external; destination_cidr_block = "10.50.0.0/16"; vpc_peering_connection_id = aws_vpc_peering_connection.ceres.id }` — pushing by EOD.
deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window created for 2026-03-24T09:00Z -> 2026-03-24T10:00Z
sam_am: One potential blocker: customer security wants audit logs forwarded into their Splunk instance via Kinesis Data Firehose (cross-account). Currently we only push to our central log bucket. Can we support cross-account delivery?
kevin_se: Options: 1) S3 cross-account bucket policy + IAM replication role (simpler), 2) Kinesis Firehose cross-account delivery (requires extra infra in their account). My preference is S3 replication to their bucket with an explicit trust role. I can draft the bucket policy.
priya_cs: Risk note for CS/AMs: if audit-forwarding isn't signed off by EOD tomorrow, legal/compliance may block cutover and this moves the account into 'renewal risk' for exec review. Please prioritize.
sam_am: Acknowledged — I scheduled a 16:00 PT sync with their security PM to close the audit-forwarding approach.
leo_net: I'll attach the route table export and a 5-step connectivity test plan: 1) verify peering status 2) verify route presence 3) traceroute to control-plane 4) curl health endpoint 5) fetch token from STS. Will post commands in PR.
kevin_se: Final KMS policy and role trust pushed to PR #4321: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321 — includes conditional `aws:SourceIp` and rotation tag.
priya_cs: tagging @michael_oncall for watch during the cutover window :eyes:
ops-bot: oncall:duty - @michael_oncall assigned for 2026-03-24 09:00Z
sam_am: Customer confirmed firewall egress rule change; they'll be ready. We will reconvene at 08:30 PT Thursday for a quick pre-cutover check-in.
priya_cs: Perfect — thanks everyone. If anything blocks, drop here and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
